name: BVH-Based Distance Field Computation with Heuristic Initialization
aliases: Heuristic BVH Traversal for Distance Fields
definition: Computation of a distance field for an isosurface approximation by finding the closest point of the isosurface for every voxel in the volume, using a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) tree.
summary: This method computes voxel-to-isosurface distances via BVH traversal, distinguished by heuristic initialization that enables aggressive early pruning.
